headline: Fine for 'LUKOIL Neftochim' over strong smell of petroleum products in Burgas
summary: Lukoil Neftochim Burgas will be sanctioned after dozens of signals about a strong smell of petroleum products and gas in Burgas. An inspection by the regional inspectorate was carried out.
why: Lukoil is a Russian oil company whose Bulgarian refinery at Burgas is a major fuel processing site, so regulatory actions there affect its operations.
